svg.aria-label: 02 — Experience. Where I’ve shipped. Front-End Developer at FTL Group (Jan 2025 — Now): Built FreightIn’s front end from Figma: rate search, quotations and shipment tracking. Cut LCP by lazy-loading heavy dependencies and removing render-blocking work. Set up the feature-based architecture and shared component layer the team still builds on. TanStack Query data layer with real loading, error and empty states; typed multi-step forms. Web Developer at Coretech Innovation (Jan — Mar 2026): Admin dashboards and control UIs for EV charging systems and EEBUS integration. Data-dense IoT and e-mobility monitoring interfaces on REST APIs. Front-End Instructor at ITI (May 2024 — Jan 2025): Taught HTML, CSS, JavaScript and React to 50+ students; supervised 10+ projects. B.Sc. Computer Science at Sohag University (2017 — 2024): Then ITI’s Front-End & Cross-Platform Mobile diploma (Nov 2023 — Apr 2024).
